subject: 岳阳慈氏塔 · 七级八角砖塔全貌
name: 岳阳慈氏塔
yearNote: 文献记南宋淳祐二年（1242）荆湖制置使孟珙重建；2015年大修时在塔顶覆钵发现“大宋治平三年”（1066）铭文与北宋早中期钱币，当地文物部门据此将建塔年份提前至1066年。年表取1066年，1242年为旧说；清嘉庆二十四年（1819）与2015年两次大修。
coordinate_source: Wikidata Q11074027（慈氏塔 Cishi Pagoda）P625 坐标 29.37092, 113.08582，塔本体近似坐标，非本项目测绘；地图显示点复用既有 hu_yueyang_city（岳阳楼显示点，塔在其南约1.5公里）。
lede: 岳阳城南塔前街的慈氏塔，是湖南现存最早的古塔之一。旧说南宋淳祐二年（1242）孟珙重建，2015年大修在塔顶覆钵发现“大宋治平三年”（1066）铭文，建塔年代因此提前。七级八角的实心砖塔高39米，层檐叠涩贴瓦、堆塑莲花，逐层内收的轮廓柔和地收向顶上的铁刹。
facts: 传唐显庆三年（658）建佛楼，后梁乾化四年（914）在故址建木塔“一字关”，北宋熙宁年间毁于火；文献记南宋淳祐二年（1242）荆湖制置使孟珙重建。
2015年大修于塔顶覆钵发现八组铭文，落款“大宋治平三年”（1066），相轮内另出土开元通宝至治平元宝钱币千余枚，当地据此将建塔年份定为1066年。
实心楼阁式砖塔，七级八角，通高39米、塔身34.58米；塔基五层花岗石，二层以上每层四面各砌佛龛，第七层平座设栏杆与望柱，八角攒尖顶立铁刹。
caption: 岳阳慈氏塔
宋 · 1066
structure_checkpoints: 八角七层，底层最高，往上逐层变矮、面阔逐层内收；每层以一道叠涩出挑的檐分隔，檐上贴青瓦，檐下有堆塑莲花（线稿以细线示意）；主图自上而下可数七层檐。
二层以上每层正面正中一龛（尖拱或圆拱形），龛内佛像只留轮廓；二层平座略凸出，转角砌倚柱；第七层平座有栏杆与望柱（补充图可见）。
塔顶八角攒尖，上立铁刹：覆钵、相轮、宝盖、圆光层叠，顶端宝珠；各层檐角挂铜铃（可省略）。
底层立在五层花岗石塔基上，正面原有塔门，清康熙年间封砌，只余石门楣轮廓；塔周为石板广场与低矮栏杆（线稿省略）。
画面去除：主图中周围的房屋、树木、围墙、人物与洞庭湖背景；补充图中的电线、电杆与街屋。
material_observations: 塔身青砖砌筑，风化后呈灰褐与青灰色，砖缝黄砂泥浆略泛黄；檐上青瓦深灰，堆塑莲花灰白；塔基花岗石浅灰；铁刹深褐近黑；佛龛内石像灰色。
author: Saigyouji-Noriko

additional_sources.author: ZSong
additional_sources.role: 街巷仰视近景（2012年），核对各层佛龛、檐部与第七层栏杆

source_note: 主图为 Saigyouji-Noriko 2024年7月自高处俯视，塔身七层、塔刹与塔基广场完整但视角略高；补充图为 ZSong 2012年自街巷仰视的近景，用于核对佛龛与檐部。线稿按正立面画，去除周围房屋、电线与背景。

Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the Chinese heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing. Match its elegant, delicate, slightly organic thin lines, restrained detail, generous blank areas, and consistent visual density. Image 2 (and subsequent photos if applicable) is SUBJECT GEOMETRY ONLY: draw the actual named monument in that reference, preserving its identifying silhouette, roof type, visible storey count, bay count, openings, and proportions.
Create a refined, sparse BLACK INK line drawing on a perfectly flat opaque PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF) background. Use confident fine contours and a few finer internal structural lines. All unmarked surfaces inside and outside the drawing remain pure white; use outlines for doors and windows rather than dark fills. No solid shadows, broad grey shading, crosshatching, pencil grain, paper texture, gradient, color, gold, halo, cast shadow or checkerboard. The white canvas will be removed later by a script; draw only the ink strokes and keep all other regions uniformly white.
Show the complete monument, centered, approximately straight-on at facade level, with verticals vertical and minimal perspective. Use only a few short ground lines. Remove tourists, foliage, vehicles, wires, modern signage, fences obstructing the structure, neighboring distractions and sky. Preserve architectural ornament selectively, without filling every roof tile or brick. No invented features. No labels, letters, calligraphy, dimension lines, captions, watermark, frame or border.
Wide compositions: landscape 1536×1024, entire building occupies about 82% of canvas width, roof/apex and base uncut, balanced breathing room. Tall pagodas: portrait 1024×1536, entire pagoda occupies about 82% of height, centred with equal side margins, apex and base uncut.

SUBJECT: the Cishi Pagoda in Yueyang, a solid octagonal SEVEN-storey brick pagoda (Image 2 shows the whole pagoda slightly from above—redraw it as a level frontal elevation; Image 3 is a street-level close-up for niche and eave detail). The first storey is the tallest; each storey above is shorter and slightly narrower, so the silhouette tapers gently. Separate the storeys with corbelled eaves of stepped brick courses capped by a thin line of tiles; from the second storey up show one small arched niche at the centre of each visible face, with the figure inside as a bare outline; the second storey has a slightly projecting ledge with corner pilasters; the seventh storey has a small balustrade with posts. Top the pagoda with an octagonal pyramidal roof and a tall iron finial of stacked bowl, rings, canopy and bead. Base: a few courses of granite with a blank lintel outline where the sealed door was. Omit the surrounding houses, trees, walls, wires, people and the lake. Portrait format, apex and base uncut.
Orientation: portrait 1024×1536.
